invariants.rationale: The method collects a sorted Stream into a list and returns it; collect(Collectors.toList()) never returns null.
The sorted operation is a permutation and does not drop or add any elements.
All input records appear in the output, assuming input is not null.
No elements are added; all elements in the result are from the input, assuming input is not null.
The result list is sorted according to the comparator used.
